warranty.title: Warranty & Parts Excellence
warranty.description: All our engine services and rebuilds are performed using Genuine OEM Parts to ensure maximum longevity and performance for your vehicle.

standardProtection.title: Standard Protection:
standardProtection.description: Every service includes our comprehensive 6 Months or 6,000 Miles Warranty as standard.

extendedCoverage.title: Looking for extended coverage?
extendedCoverage.description: We also offer up to 24 Months Warranty, sourced directly from main dealers. Please note, this option comes at a higher cost due to the extended protection and premium coverage.

modelsContent.title: Specialist Engine Services for Multiple Models
paragraphs: Our specialist team provides professional engine services across a wide range of vehicle models. Every vehicle is assessed individually to identify the exact cause of the issue before any repair work begins.
We use manufacturer-quality components and specialist diagnostic equipment to ensure accurate repairs and dependable long-term performance.

faqs.question: How long does an engine service take?
faqs.answer: The time required depends on the vehicle model and the type of service or repair required. After an initial inspection, our specialists can provide a more accurate estimate.

faqs.question: Do you use genuine OEM parts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use genuine OEM parts wherever required to maintain the quality, reliability and performance of your vehicle.

faqs.question: Do you provide a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our standard protection includes a 6 Months or 6,000 Miles Warranty, with extended warranty options available for eligible services.
